00084     virtual SoundFrame& tick () {
00085         if (!m_m) {
00086             double d = m_osc->fastTick (); // MUST be not interpolated
00087             if (m_antiRumble) {
00088                 d = m_rumble->process (d); 
00089             }
00090             m_frame->set (Pandora::LEFT, (d * (1 - m_rightPosition)) * m_sourceLevel);    
00091             m_frame->set (Pandora::RIGHT, (d * m_rightPosition) * m_sourceLevel);
00092             
00093             m_curr = m_pdet->process (d);
00094             if (m_curr > MIN_FREQ_LIMIT &&
00095                 (fabs (m_curr - m_old) > fabs ((m_old * TUNINGSEMITONE) - m_old))) {
00096                 m_old = m_curr;
00097     //              for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VOICES; i++) {
00098     //                  m_pshifts[i]->freeze (true);
00099     //              }
00100                         
00101                 double ratio = m_curr / m_masterPitch;
00102                 while (ratio >= 2) {
00103                     ratio /= 2;
00104                 }
00105                 while (ratio < 1) {
00106                     ratio *= 2;
00107                 }
00108                 int index = 0; 
00109                 double maxDiff = 2;
00110                 for (int i = 0; i < m_scaleSize; i++) {
00111                     double diff = 0;
00112                     diff = fabs (ratio - m_scale[i]);
00113             
00114                     if (diff < maxDiff) {
00115                         maxDiff = diff;
00116                         index = i;
00117                     }
00118                 }
00119                 if (index == m_scaleSize - 1) {
00120                     if (fabs (ratio - (2 * m_scale[0])) < maxDiff) {
00121                         index = 0;
00122                     }
00123                 }
00124     
00125                 if (index != m_indexCopy) {
00126     //                  for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VOICES; i++) {
00127     //                      m_pshifts[i]->freeze (false);
00128     //                  }
00129     //                                          
00130                     m_indexCopy = index;
00131                     updateRatios (index);
00132                 }
00133             }
00134             for (int i = 0; i < MAX_VOICES; i++) {
00135                 SoundFrame f;
00136                 f = m_pshifts[i]->tick ();
00137                 f.mul (Pandora::LEFT, m_harmonyLevel);
00138                 f.mul (Pandora::RIGHT, m_harmonyLevel);
00139                 
00140                 if (m_bypass == false) {  
00141                     if (m_activeVoices[i] == true) {
00142                         *m_frame += f;    
00143                     }
00144                 }       
00145             }       
00146         } 
00147         
00148 //      m_ucurr++;
00149 //      m_ucurr %= m_usample;
00150         return *m_frame;
00151     }
